high_level_description: This image is a digital representation of the solar system, specifically focusing on the orbits of Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, and a comet labeled as "3I/Comet." The background is a dark, starry space, giving the impression of being set in outer space. Planets: Mercury: Located closest to the center, depicted with a small white dot. Venus: Positioned slightly further out from Mercury. Earth: Situated even farther from the center. Mars: Placed beyond Earth, closer to the edge
